scope: F2 fold-0 screen. Supervised mixed-factor model: factorization machine style interactions with learned embeddings for categorical features, combined with linear terms.

H68_MIXED_FACTOR.question: Does a supervised mixed-factor model (FM-style embeddings for categoricals + linear terms) improve fold-0 OOF AUC on the rich view?
H68_MIXED_FACTOR.method: Use sklearn's FactorizationMachineClassifier (or implement FM with embeddings for categorical features: Gender, Customer Type, Type of Travel, Class). Train on rich view folds 1-4, predict fold-0. Measure fold-0 port_delta vs champion proxy.
H68_MIXED_FACTOR.leakage: Embeddings learned on FIT only (folds 1-4). Fold-safe.
H68_MIXED_FACTOR.decision_rule: PROMISING if fold-0 port_delta >= +5e-5 AND corr_vs_portfolio < 0.995.
